BACKGROUND

A little background

In her note on Romance, Kim Sawol describes running toward something that won’t last and loving anyway, and coming to know yourself better through love.

  • Bugs — Romance: Kim Sawol’s note, album notes and credits (Korean) ↗

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Reassurance with doubt underneath

  • Self-worth
  • Loneliness

Much of Someone addresses another person as precious and loved. Then the lyric turns towards the speaker’s own lonely night. The confidence of the reassurance becomes more complicated once the person offering it admits feeling unloved.

That change of perspective leaves tenderness and doubt close together. Being able to recognise someone else’s worth does not make it easy to feel your own. The speaker can offer conviction to another person while still needing to hear something like it themselves.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 김사월

Kim Sawol

Kim Sawol is a folk singer-songwriter whose songs look closely at love, loneliness and the contradictions of everyday life.

She began releasing music with Kim Haewon in 2014 and made her solo debut with Suzanne in 2015.
